description: Na₂CoGeO₄ is beta beryllia-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.38 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.34 Å. Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.01 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.78 Å) and three longer (1.79 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Co, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂CoGe tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Co, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂CoGe tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Co, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂CoGe tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Co, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂CoGe tetrahedra.
